Senior Product Designer — Yuvabe

We are looking for a Senior Product Designer to lead the design of our recruiter-facing ATS product.
You will own end-to-end design: from user research and wireframes through to polished, production-ready UI.

Responsibilities:
- Lead end-to-end product design from discovery to delivery
- Conduct user research and translate insights into design decisions
- Create wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity UI in Figma
- Collaborate closely with engineers to ensure design quality in production
- Maintain and evolve the design system
- Present design decisions to stakeholders and leadership

Requirements:
- 5+ years of product design experience
- Strong proficiency in Figma
- Experience designing complex data-heavy dashboards
- Portfolio demonstrating end-to-end product work
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
- Experience working in agile / sprint-based teams

Nice to have:
- Experience building or maintaining a design system
- Familiarity with accessibility standards (WCAG AA)
- Background working closely with engineering teams
- Knowledge of front-end basics (HTML, CSS)

We offer remote-first work, flexible hours, competitive compensation, and a collaborative team culture.
